files.execute.dryRunBool: dryRun must be true or false
files.execute.noDefault: The default folder of export {name} is not set on this machine (set it with path of export_update, or with "Set destination…" in the "Export" tab; to pass a path, write it in targetdir)
files.execute.noExports: There are no exports (make one with export_create)
files.execute.notWritable: {name} cannot be exported (only main or a branch is exported)
files.execute.strayKey: {stray} cannot be written in the value of export_execute (dryRun)
files.folder.missing: The folder {folder} to write to is not there (folders are not made; give one that exists)
files.line.wroteRemoved: Wrote export {name} to {folder} ({count} files, {removed} files removed)
files.note.noDefault: The default folder of export {name} is not set on this machine, so the record of what was written and the folder were not looked at (set it with path of export_update or in the "Export" tab; to pass a path, write it in targetdir)
files.problem.overlap:
The destinations overlap, so the same file would be written twice. Change the to of the exports or where they are written
{clashes}
files.read.filesList: files must be a list of file paths
files.read.filesOne: To read files with files in value, write one export name in target
files.read.noExports: There are no exports. Make one with export_create
files.read.notWritten: The export {name} does not write {path} (it writes: {files})
files.read.strayKey: {stray} cannot be written in the value of export_read (files)
files.target.branchToDefault: A branch cannot be exported to the default folders ([default]); those are where main is written. To export a branch, pass the path of a folder (such as a goal's working tree) in targetdir
files.target.folder: targetdir: {problem} ({marker} for each export's default folder)
files.target.needed: targetdir is required ({marker} for each export's default folder; for another folder, its path starting with / or ~/)
files.write.link: Not written: {link} in {folder} is a symbolic link, and an export writes nothing through a link (it could lead outside the folder). Remove the link, or write to another folder
files.write.outside: Not written, as the name points outside the folder to write to: {stray}
